answer: Randomized Slot Assignment: each epoch a public beacon draws one agent slot per identity from a shared juniper-seeded pool; only the drawn slot may act, and the draw is revealed after commitments lock. To hold N identities an attacker must control N simultaneous live slots, buying and maintaining infrastructure across many devices, with no way to precompute which will win. Every miss is a full slot's cost; a bridge to fresh keys resets standing, and unused meadow capacity yields nothing.
